title: The pixel value of the index color is the palette number
summary: Color type 3 samples are indexed into the PLTE, and each entry is three 8-bit RGB components.
detail: Low bit depth images will pack multiple indices into a single byte, unpacking first and then looking up the color.
boundary: Table item colors do not have to be unique. The same display color cannot uniquely deduce the original index.
relevance: When analyzing two identical looking images, be able to differentiate between index data changes and palette changes.
